metadata.description: AgentAvow — signed, verifiable safety grades for the tools your AI agent connects to.

plugins.name: agentavow-trust
plugins.description: Scan any MCP server, package, or repo for a signed 0-100 trust score before you trust it. Bundles the AgentAvow MCP connector, a /scan command, a scan-before-connect skill, a session-start hook that grades newly added MCP servers, and a per-call gate for blocked servers and changed tool definitions.
